prophecies.title: Born of a virgin
prophecies.note: Isaiah gave Ahaz a sign that a virgin would conceive and bear a son called Immanuel, and Matthew says Mary's conception by the Holy Ghost came to pass that this might be fulfilled.

prophecies.title: Born in Bethlehem
prophecies.note: Micah named Bethlehem Ephratah as the place a ruler of Israel would come from, and the chief priests and scribes quote it to Herod when the wise men ask where Christ was to be born.

prophecies.title: Called out of Egypt
prophecies.note: Hosea has God say he called his son out of Egypt, and Matthew sees it in the return of the child Jesus after Herod's death.

prophecies.title: Rachel weeping for her children
prophecies.note: Jeremiah heard Rachel weeping for her children, and Matthew finds that grief again when Herod kills the boys of Bethlehem.

prophecies.title: The voice in the wilderness
prophecies.note: Isaiah and Malachi foretold a messenger preparing the way of the Lord, and the gospels name John the Baptist as that voice.

prophecies.title: Elijah before the day of the Lord
prophecies.note: Malachi promised that Elijah would come before the great day, and Jesus says of John the Baptist, this is Elias, which was for to come.

prophecies.title: A light in Galilee of the nations
prophecies.note: Isaiah spoke of a great light for the people in Zebulun and Naphtali, and Matthew sets Jesus' move to Capernaum and his first preaching there as that fulfilment.

prophecies.title: The Spirit upon the Lord's anointed
prophecies.note: Jesus reads Isaiah's words in the synagogue at Nazareth and says, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

prophecies.title: He took our infirmities
prophecies.note: After Jesus heals many at Capernaum, Matthew says it was that Isaiah's words, he bare our sicknesses, might be fulfilled.

prophecies.title: The chosen servant
prophecies.note: Matthew says Jesus' healing and his charge to keep it quiet fulfilled Isaiah's word about the servant in whom God's soul delights.

prophecies.title: Speaking in parables
prophecies.note: Matthew says Jesus spoke to the crowds only in parables to fulfil the psalmist's words, I will open my mouth in parables.

prophecies.title: The king on a donkey
prophecies.note: Zechariah told Zion that her king comes lowly, riding on an ass, and Matthew and John say Jesus' entry into Jerusalem was that fulfilment.

prophecies.title: Praise from the mouths of children
prophecies.note: When children cry Hosanna in the temple, Jesus answers the priests' protest by quoting the psalm about praise from babes and sucklings.

prophecies.title: The stone the builders rejected
prophecies.note: Jesus applies the psalm's rejected stone to himself, and Peter tells the rulers that the stone they set at nought has become the head of the corner.

prophecies.title: Zeal for the Lord's house
prophecies.note: When Jesus drives the traders out of the temple, his disciples remember the psalm, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

prophecies.title: Hated without a cause
prophecies.note: Jesus says his enemies' hatred fulfils the word written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

prophecies.title: Who has believed our report
prophecies.note: John says that although Jesus did many miracles the people did not believe, that Isaiah's words might be fulfilled.

prophecies.title: Betrayed by a friend
prophecies.note: Jesus quotes the psalm, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me, and then gives the sop to Judas.

prophecies.title: Thirty pieces of silver
prophecies.note: Zechariah was paid thirty pieces of silver, which he threw to the potter in the house of the Lord, and Matthew tells of Judas's price, its return to the temple and the potter's field.

prophecies.title: The sheep scattered
prophecies.note: Jesus quotes Zechariah, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered, and when he is arrested all the disciples forsake him and flee.

prophecies.title: Numbered with the transgressors
prophecies.note: Jesus says Isaiah's words, he was reckoned among the transgressors, must be accomplished in him, and he is crucified between two thieves.

prophecies.title: Silent before his accusers
prophecies.note: Isaiah says the servant opened not his mouth, Jesus gives Pilate no answer, and Philip shows the Ethiopian that the passage speaks of Jesus.

prophecies.title: His garments divided
prophecies.note: The psalmist wrote that they part my garments among them and cast lots upon my vesture, and John says the soldiers did this at the cross that the scripture might be fulfilled.

prophecies.title: My God, why hast thou forsaken me
prophecies.note: Jesus cries the opening words of the psalm from the cross in the ninth hour.

prophecies.title: Given vinegar to drink
prophecies.note: The psalmist says they gave me vinegar to drink, and John says Jesus, that the scripture might be fulfilled, said I thirst and was given vinegar.

prophecies.title: They shall look on him whom they pierced
prophecies.note: After Jesus died a soldier pierced his side with a spear, and John says this was that another scripture should be fulfilled, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

prophecies.title: Not a bone broken
prophecies.note: The soldiers broke the legs of the two others but found Jesus already dead, and John says this was that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

prophecies.title: With the rich in his death
prophecies.note: Isaiah said the servant would make his grave with the rich in his death, and Joseph of Arimathaea, a rich man, lays Jesus in his own new tomb.

prophecies.title: Not left in the grave
prophecies.note: Peter and Paul both argue that David's words, thou wilt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption, were spoken of the resurrection of Christ and not of David himself.

prophecies.title: The sign of Jonah
prophecies.note: Jesus says that as Jonah was three days and three nights in the fish's belly so the Son of man will be in the heart of the earth, and at the empty tomb the angel says he is risen, as he said.

prophecies.title: A prophet like Moses
prophecies.note: Peter and Stephen both say that the prophet Moses promised God would raise up is Jesus.

prophecies.title: In thy seed shall all nations be blessed
prophecies.note: Peter and Paul both read God's promise to Abraham as a promise fulfilled in Christ, the one seed through whom the blessing reaches the nations.

prophecies.title: A son for David and his throne
prophecies.note: God promised David a son whose kingdom would be established forever, and Gabriel tells Mary her son will be given the throne of his father David.

prophecies.title: Sit thou at my right hand
prophecies.note: Peter argues that David did not ascend into the heavens, so the psalm's Lord seated at God's right hand is the risen Jesus.

prophecies.title: Thou art my Son
prophecies.note: Paul preaches that God's raising of Jesus fulfilled the words, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

prophecies.title: A priest after the order of Melchizedek
prophecies.note: Hebrews argues that the psalm's oath of a priest forever after Melchizedek's order is fulfilled in Jesus and not in the line of Aaron.

prophecies.title: A light to the Gentiles
prophecies.note: Simeon calls the child Jesus a light to lighten the Gentiles, and Paul and Barnabas turn to the Gentiles saying the Lord has commanded this by Isaiah's words.

prophecies.title: The tabernacle of David rebuilt
prophecies.note: James cites Amos at the Jerusalem council as agreeing with Simeon's account of God taking out of the Gentiles a people for his name.

prophecies.title: The Gentiles shall hope in him
prophecies.note: Paul strings together the law, the psalms and Isaiah to show that Christ became a minister to the circumcision so that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy.

prophecies.title: The Spirit poured out
prophecies.note: At Pentecost, when the Spirit fills the disciples and they speak in other tongues, Peter says, This is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel.

prophecies.title: A new covenant
prophecies.note: Jeremiah promised a new covenant with Israel, and Jesus speaks of the cup as the new testament in his blood while Hebrews quotes Jeremiah in full to say it has come.

prophecies.title: Wait for the promise of the Father
prophecies.note: Jesus told the disciples to wait at Jerusalem to be baptized with the Holy Ghost, and at Pentecost they are all filled with the Holy Ghost.

prophecies.title: Peter's three denials
prophecies.note: Jesus says that before the cock crows Peter will deny him thrice, and Peter does so in the high priest's courtyard and then remembers the word of Jesus.

prophecies.title: He will rise on the third day
prophecies.note: Jesus told his disciples he would be killed and rise the third day, and the angel at the empty tomb says, He is risen, as he said.

prophecies.title: A son for Zacharias
prophecies.note: Gabriel told Zacharias that Elisabeth would bear a son named John and that he would be dumb until it happened, and both come to pass when the child is born and named.

prophecies.title: Simeon will see the Lord's Christ
prophecies.note: The Holy Ghost told Simeon he would not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ, and he takes the child Jesus in his arms in the temple.

prophecies.title: A great dearth throughout the world
prophecies.note: The prophet Agabus signified a great famine, and the text says it came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar, when the disciples sent relief to Judaea.

prophecies.title: Paul to be bound at Jerusalem
prophecies.note: Agabus bound his own hands and feet to show that the Jews would bind Paul at Jerusalem and deliver him to the Gentiles, which follows in the temple riot and Paul's arrest.

prophecies.title: No loss of life but the ship
prophecies.note: An angel told Paul that all who sailed with him would be saved, and though the ship broke up on the shoal everyone reached land safely.

prophecies.title: A stranger in a land for four hundred years
prophecies.note: God told Abram his seed would be strangers in a land not theirs and afterward come out with great substance, and Exodus says they left on the selfsame day the sojourn ended.

prophecies.title: They shall come out with great substance
prophecies.note: The Israelites ask the Egyptians for silver, gold and clothing, and the Lord gives them favor so that they spoil Egypt.

prophecies.title: Carry up my bones from hence
prophecies.note: Joseph made the children of Israel swear to carry his bones out of Egypt, and Moses takes them at the exodus and they are buried at Shechem.

prophecies.title: Joseph's sheaves and stars
prophecies.note: Joseph dreamed that his brothers would bow down to him, and when they come to buy grain in Egypt they bow before him and he remembers the dreams.

prophecies.title: Seven years of plenty and seven of famine
prophecies.note: Joseph told Pharaoh God had shown what he was about to do, and the seven plenteous years and then the dearth came as he said.

prophecies.title: The land promised to Abraham's seed
prophecies.note: God gave Abram the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates, and Joshua says there failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken.

prophecies.title: A son for Sarah
prophecies.note: God said Sarah would bear Abraham a son at the set time, and the text says the Lord did unto her as he had spoken.

prophecies.title: Twelve princes from Ishmael
prophecies.note: God promised to make Ishmael fruitful and beget twelve princes, and Genesis lists twelve sons of Ishmael by their names.

prophecies.title: The rebuilding of Jericho
prophecies.note: Joshua cursed the man who would rebuild Jericho, and Hiel of Bethel rebuilt it at the cost of his firstborn and youngest sons according to the word of the Lord.

prophecies.title: The three signs for Saul
prophecies.note: Samuel told Saul of three signs on his way home, and the text says all those signs came to pass that day.

prophecies.title: The house of Eli
prophecies.note: A man of God and then the Lord himself told Eli his sons would die the same day and his house lose the priesthood, which follows with Hophni and Phinehas and the removal of Abiathar.

prophecies.title: The sword shall never depart
prophecies.note: Nathan told David that the sword would never leave his house and that a neighbour would lie with his wives in the sight of the sun, and Absalom goes in to his father's concubines on the rooftop in the sight of all Israel.

prophecies.title: Solomon builds the house
prophecies.note: Nathan told David his son would build a house for the Lord's name, and Solomon says at the dedication that the Lord has performed his word.

prophecies.title: The kingdom torn from Solomon's house
prophecies.note: Ahijah told Jeroboam that ten tribes would be taken from Solomon's line, and the text says Rehoboam's refusal of the people was a cause from the Lord that he might perform his saying.

prophecies.title: The altar at Bethel torn apart
prophecies.note: The man of God gave a sign that the altar would be rent and its ashes poured out, and when Jeroboam stretches out his hand the altar is rent and the ashes poured out.

prophecies.title: A king named Josiah
prophecies.note: The man of God cried against the altar at Bethel that a child named Josiah would burn men's bones on it, and Josiah breaks the altar and burns bones on it according to the word of the Lord.

prophecies.title: The house of Jeroboam cut off
prophecies.note: Ahijah told Jeroboam's wife that her son would die and that the whole house would be cut off, and Baasha destroys it according to the saying of the Lord.

prophecies.title: The house of Baasha cut off
prophecies.note: Jehu the son of Hanani told Baasha that his house would be made like the house of Jeroboam, and Zimri slays all his house according to the word of the Lord.

prophecies.title: The widow's barrel of meal
prophecies.note: Elijah told the widow of Zarephath that the meal and oil would not fail until the Lord sent rain, and the text says they did not fail according to the word of the Lord.

prophecies.title: Years of drought, then rain
prophecies.note: Elijah said there would be neither dew nor rain but by his word, and after the years of drought the Lord sends rain after the contest at Carmel.

prophecies.title: The dogs lick Ahab's blood
prophecies.note: Elijah told Ahab that dogs would lick his blood and that dogs would eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel, and the text records both according to the word of the Lord.

prophecies.title: The house of Ahab destroyed
prophecies.note: Jehu kills the sons of Ahab and all that remained of his house in Jezreel and says that nothing of the word the Lord spoke concerning Ahab's house shall fall to the earth.

prophecies.title: Ahaziah shall not come down from his bed
prophecies.note: Elijah told Ahaziah that he would die for sending to Baalzebub, and the text says he died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken.

prophecies.title: Water in the valley
prophecies.note: Elisha told the three kings to dig ditches in the valley and said they would be filled without wind or rain, and in the morning water comes by way of Edom.

prophecies.title: Plenty in the gate of Samaria
prophecies.note: Elisha said that flour and barley would sell cheaply at the gate of Samaria the next day, and it did as the man of God had said, while the doubting lord was trampled at the gate.

prophecies.title: Four generations for Jehu
prophecies.note: The Lord told Jehu his sons would sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation, and the text says this was the word of the Lord when Zachariah reigned and was killed.

prophecies.title: Israel led away into Assyria
prophecies.note: Amos said Israel would surely be led away captive out of their land, and the writer of Kings says the Lord removed Israel out of his sight as he had said by all his servants the prophets.

prophecies.title: The two kings forsaken
prophecies.note: Isaiah told Ahaz that the land of the two kings he dreaded would be forsaken, and Assyria carries away Israel's northern tribes, kills Rezin and Hoshea slays Pekah.

prophecies.title: Sennacherib turned back
prophecies.note: Isaiah said that the king of Assyria would hear a rumour, return to his land and fall by the sword there, and after the angel strikes his camp he goes home and his sons kill him in the house of Nisroch.

prophecies.title: Hezekiah's sons carried to Babylon
prophecies.note: Isaiah told Hezekiah that all in his house would be carried to Babylon and some of his sons made eunuchs, and Nebuchadnezzar takes the treasures and young men of the royal line.

prophecies.title: Zion ploughed as a field
prophecies.note: Micah said Zion would be ploughed as a field, and the Babylonians burn the house of the Lord and the city, so that the mountain of Zion is desolate.

prophecies.title: Judah given into the hand of Babylon
prophecies.note: Jeremiah said the Lord would give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and the book of Kings records the deportations and the burning of Jerusalem.

prophecies.title: Hananiah shall die this year
prophecies.note: Jeremiah told the false prophet Hananiah that he would die within the year, and Hananiah dies in the seventh month the same year.

prophecies.title: Zedekiah brought to Babylon but not seeing it
prophecies.note: Ezekiel said the prince would be brought to Babylon yet not see it though he die there, and Zedekiah is blinded by Nebuchadnezzar and carried to Babylon.

prophecies.title: Seventy years in Babylon
prophecies.note: Jeremiah said the land would serve Babylon seventy years, and Chronicles says the captivity lasted until the land had kept her sabbaths and the Lord stirred up Cyrus, while Daniel understood by books the number of the years.

prophecies.title: Cyrus named by Isaiah
prophecies.note: Isaiah named Cyrus as the Lord's shepherd who would say that Jerusalem should be built, and Ezra says the Lord stirred up Cyrus to proclaim the rebuilding of the house at Jerusalem.

prophecies.title: Zerubbabel finishes the house
prophecies.note: Zechariah said Zerubbabel's hands had laid the foundation and would finish the house, and Ezra says the elders built and finished it through the prophesying of Haggai and Zechariah.

prophecies.title: Babylon falls to the Medes
prophecies.note: Isaiah said God would stir up the Medes against Babylon, and Daniel records that in that night Belshazzar was slain and Darius the Median took the kingdom.

prophecies.title: Nebuchadnezzar driven from men
prophecies.note: Daniel told Nebuchadnezzar that he would be driven from men to dwell with the beasts until he knew God ruled, and the same hour it falls upon him and later his understanding returns.
